accuracyPolicy.claimable: Features with live UI + backend APIs in production code paths
accuracyPolicy.claimWithHedge: Nav-labeled features, seeded provider catalogs, or partial scaffolding

oneLiner: Codiic is an India-ready, Shopify-style ecommerce platform: merchants get a full admin + visual storefront/theme tools; shoppers get a hosted React storefront; Codiic staff run themes, plans, and support from an internal admin.

elevatorPitch.short: Launch and run an online store with products, orders, markets, content, discounts, and a no-code theme builder—optimized for Indian payments (UPI, COD, bank transfer) and GST.
elevatorPitch.medium: Codiic gives merchants a complete store admin (catalog, inventory, orders, customers, marketing, markets) plus a hosted online store with installable theme packs and a Create Theme visual builder. Payments start India-native (UPI with UTR verification, COD, bank transfer). Custom domains, blogs, policies, checkout branding, and staff permissions are built in. An internal Codiic Admin operates membership plans, theme catalog publishing, and merchant support.

differentiators: India-first money rails: UPI (QR + UTR review), COD, bank transfer
India tax readiness: GST / IGST configuration with India market bootstrap
Visual Create Theme builder + installable React theme packs (Horizon, Watch, and more)
Hosted storefront runtime separate from themes (themes control look; platform owns cart/checkout/SEO/auth)
Multi-market catalogs, multi-location inventory, transfers, purchase orders
Built-in marketing automations builder, discounts suite, blogs/CMS
AI assistant Codiix for merchant/theme help
Platform ops console for theme marketplace, SaaS plans, hire-a-developer workflow
